question: A line segment parallel to the vertical axis has length 8. What length should it have in an oblique dimetric drawing?
solution:
With the recorded interpretation of “vertical axis” as the original planar \(y\)-axis of a horizontally placed figure, a parallel line segment is drawn at half its original length. Its drawn length is therefore \(8/2=4\).

This interpretation matters: an upright spatial axis keeps its full length in the usual school spatial extension, which would give \(8\). Thus the answer \(4\) depends on the recorded planar-axis interpretation.
